title: Deterioration Alert Under Constrained Review Capacity
decision_question: Which alert threshold produces an operationally safe balance between missed deterioration and review burden?
objectives: Translate sensitivity and specificity into daily workload.
Connect threshold selection to response capacity.
Quantify missed cases, false alerts, and unreviewed alerts.
Use abstention or staged review when no threshold is adequate.
chapter_title: Human–AI Decision Systems and Managerial Action
